definitions.explanation: A wide, major road in a city or town, typically with multiple lanes and often lined with shops and buildings.

examples.japanese: {大通|おおどお}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}いた→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: I walked along the main street.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{大通|おおどお}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{面|めん}している→面する：14629_mensuru⟧。
examples.english: That shop faces the main street.

examples.japanese: {大通|おおどお}り⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{一本|いっぽん}→一本：08888_ippon⟧⟦{裏|うら}→裏：02178_ura⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧な⟦{住宅街|じゅうたくがい}→住宅街：09394_juutakugai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっている→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: One block off the main street, a quiet residential area stretches out.

notes:
Refers to any wide, busy road, typically the main thoroughfare in a town or city. Many Japanese cities have streets officially named {大通|おおどお}り, such as Sapporo's famous {大通|おおどお}り⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大通|おおどお}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{面|めん}する→面する：14629_mensuru⟧: to face the main street
- {大通|おおどお}り{沿|ぞ}い: along the main street
- ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧{大通|おおどお}り: the main street in front of the station
- {大通|おおどお}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{渡|わた}る→渡る：02441_wataru⟧: to cross the main street

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{通|とお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧: street; road — a general term for any street
- {目抜|めぬ}き{通|どお}り: high street; main shopping street — emphasizes commercial activity
- ⟦{裏通|うらどお}り→裏通り：09383_uradoori⟧: back street; side street — the opposite of {大通|おおどお}り
